data: What is the approximate value of the red line at the end of training?

The red line represents the average accuracy of the 100 randomly initialized models. At the end of training, which corresponds to approximately 20 epochs, the red line appears to be around 86%. This can be inferred from the position of the red line relative to the y-axis and the range of the gray shaded area, which represents the 95% confidence interval.
